requirements.title: Responsible-Use Deployment Gate
requirements.description: Harm protection is a set of CONFIGURABLE controls, not a capability allowlist. No image capability is blocked at the code layer: identity/appearance edits (face transfer, clothing/hair/makeup changes) are ordinary operations. A public/monetized deployment defaults to content scan on, provenance/attribution marking on (>= real-person edits), a published Acceptable-Use Policy, consent affirmation + logging on identity-altering ops, and abuse rate-limiting. Each control is independently overridable (IMAGE_TOOLS_REQUIRE_CONSENT, IMAGE_TOOLS_NSFW_SCAN, IMAGE_TOOLS_REQUIRE_PROVENANCE, IMAGE_TOOLS_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN); local defaults are permissive. The only non-configurable refusal is sexual content involving minors, and it is enforced rather than asserted: the bundled reviewer runs on every tier (profile-driven classifiers, face and age stages, optional face-independent second opinion), a public tier with no reviewer refuses image output, a technical reviewer failure is classified safety_unavailable (503) and fails closed, and refused bytes are never published: they are deleted immediately, or moved to a private TTL-bounded quarantine for admin review (local 168h, public 0h by default). The reviewer is selected by a validated declarative profile (api/internal/safety/profiles.json; IMAGE_TOOLS_SAFETY_PROFILE/_NAME/_MODE/_ON_REFUSAL) and IMAGE_TOOLS_MINOR_SAFETY_CMD can replace it. Built in api/internal/safety (tier preset + per-control overrides + op-weight table + consent log + rate limiter + review profile/reviewer seam) and enforced on the AI submit edge (handlers/ai); discovery via SafetyService.GetPolicy uses the same resolved policy and reports reviewer health. Naturalize is low-weight; identity/body/clothing/appearance edits are high-weight. A false-positive loop lets an operator label a refusal/flag as legitimate, confirmed or uncertain; the label snapshots the reviewer evidence (scores, thresholds, face measurements, profile/version) into a JSON Lines corpus that scripts/safety-corpus-replay.py can replay at candidate thresholds. Feedback never restores a refused output, unblurs a sensitive result, or changes a stored verdict. The quarantine is reachable only through GET /api/v1/safety/quarantine/{id} after the local operator (ungated) or a public deployment with IMAGE_TOOLS_SAFETY_QUARANTINE_TOKEN reviews it; the ordinary /api/v1/blobs/ route refuses the namespace, and a janitor purges expired entries.

validation.notes: Policy/tier/op-weight/consent-log/rate-limiter logic: local unrestricted; public blocks high-weight ops without consent, forces NSFW scan, records affirmed consent.
Submit-edge enforcement: public tier returns 403 for an identity-altering op without consent_affirmed; never blocks none-weight ops or the local tier.
SafetyService.GetPolicy reports the resolved policy + op-weight table for local and public tiers.

Minor-safety reviewer contract (JSON stdin/stdout, no shell), profile validation, structured action/reason codes, malformed output, bounded input; required-without-detector is unavailable; a refusal refuses; a technical reviewer error is unavailable/fails closed; local tier never consults the input reviewer.
Output review runs regardless of the request flag; a HardRefusal fails the job and deletes the produced artifacts; a review error also deletes them (fail closed).
Public submit edge returns 503 unavailable when the required reviewer is absent or fails technically, and 403 on a genuine minor+sexual refusal.
Declarative profile loading/validation/override, strict thresholds, model-id derivation, second-opinion confidence floor, and reviewer health.

A feedback case snapshots the per-variation classifier scores, face measurements, profile and reviewer version; a ref outside the reviewed batch, a clean verdict, a bad label and an oversized note are rejected; upsert, stats, filtering and JSONL export are covered.

RecordSafetyFeedback labels a refused job and rejects a clean job (412) or an unspecified label (400); list filtering, stats, corpus export and clear run over the Connect handler with a fake job source and SQLite.

The exported corpus replays the sexual/age decision at the recorded and candidate thresholds; a refused case is compared on the refusal decision, a flagged case on the sexual decision, uncertain/non-replayable cases stay out of the matrix, and unassessable cases are flagged second-opinion-dependent.

A refused output is stored under quarantine/, listed, opened only while pending, and purged with its blob at expiry; zero retention disables quarantine; a missing job id is rejected; IsKey rejects lookalike keys.

Local quarantine review is ungated; a public deployment requires the admin token (412 without configuration, 403 without the header); the image route serves no-store bytes, supports download, and returns 410 after expiry.
The ordinary /api/v1/blobs/ route returns 404 for a quarantine key, so a refused output is never reachable as a published result.

The engine copies a refused variation into quarantine with its finding and bytes before deleting the original; a quarantine write failure still deletes the original and records safety_quarantine_error.
